description: The Subaru Justy is a subcompact hatchback manufactured and marketed by Japanese automaker Subaru since 1984. The company has marketed a rebadged variant known as the Daihatsu Boon, at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show with could be optioned with a 1.0 or 1.2-litre inline-3 engine, front/four wheel drive, electronically controlled continuously variable transaxle, or a 5-speed manual transaxle. For the 2010 model year, the Justy was replaced with the Subaru Trezia. The Justy nameplate was revived in November 2016 as a rebadged Toyota Tank and its twin counterpart the Toyota Roomy and Daihatsu Thor.
